preamble: Owner rulings that shape the kit. The evidence for each lives in docs/design.md §5.

decisions.text: License: MIT, with SPDX headers in the kit-owned scripts. docs/design.md §5.2.
Publishing: deferred. No remote, no npm publish, no marketplace registration until the owner rules. docs/design.md §5.3.
tag-pilot adoption: deferred until PR #42 is merged; tag-pilot stays the upstream of the kit-owned files until then. docs/design.md §5.4.
Dogfooding: this repository installs its own kit (id prefix HR); the root copies stay equal to template/. docs/design.md §5.5.
SessionStart matcher: startup|resume|clear|fork for the ritual, compact for the standing rules. docs/design.md §5.6.

Bootstrap exception: batch 1 (spec 'batch 0') was implemented by the orchestrator on Fable without a mightier reviewer, because the agent layer was installed only by its last task. From batch 2 on, every change goes through implementer, task-reviewer, and branch-reviewer under process.model-policy.
Package manager: pnpm only, never npm or npx; the workspace follows tag-pilot (exact mise pins for node and pnpm, pnpm-lock.yaml, mise tasks setup, test, lint, audit). docs/design.md §5.7.
